verse.text: He must manage his own family well, having children who respect and obey him. For if a man cannot manage his own household, how can he take care of God's church?

video.title: The Perfect Father | Psalm 68:5 | Our Daily Bread Video Devotional

reflection: You don't have to have it all figured out to lead your home well — Paul just says manage it, show up, keep your word, and let your kids see a man who's steady. That might look like sticking to bedtime prayers even when you're exhausted, or apologizing when you blow it, because respect gets built in the small daily moments, not the grand speeches. If you can't be trusted at your own kitchen table, no title or platform will fix that — so start there.
